source.title: New estimates of the nonlinear Fourier transform for the defocusing NLS equation
source.author: Jan-Cornelius Molnar
source.served_file_note: The version banner says 6 Oct 2015; the served PDF has a June 1, 2021 footer. The SHA-256 pins the actual downloaded binary.
source.private_source_retention: PDF and extracted text retained in originating chat work/sources; not distributed in repository.

baseline.access: read_only_reference_snapshot; implementation in separate articles/dnls-estimates worktree

normalizations.pair_norm: component-sum Hilbert norm, not a product maximum
normalizations.paper_first_component_fourier_exponent: -i*2*n*pi*x; library uses +i*2*n*pi*x in both components, so reflect the first coefficient index
normalizations.weighted_domain_topology: norm topology in weighted coordinates, not the ambient L2 topology
normalizations.real_form: realTypeSourceLocus 2; conjugate-reflected coefficients in the library convention
normalizations.weight_class: SpectralWeight: one_le, neg_eq, add_le, monotone_nat; w(0)=1 is not imposed
normalizations.linear_factor: SpectralWeight.HasLinearFactor: exists v in M, w(n)=(1+|n|)*v(n)

statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.quantifiers: One original map, then for every natural m>=1 choose c_m,d_m>0, then every real H^m source.

statements.label: Theorem 2 and common-constant remark
statements.quantifiers: The same c_m,d_m as Theorem 1, before every real H^m source, for every natural m>=1.

statements.label: Theorem 3
statements.quantifiers: For every w in M^1 choose c_w>0 and a complex open neighborhood T of the entire real weighted subspace. Action bound for every complex source in T; Birkhoff bound for every real weighted source.

statements.label: Corollary 1
statements.quantifiers: For every real r>=1 choose c_r>0 and a complex open H^r neighborhood of the entire real H^r subspace. Action bound there, coordinate bound on real H^r.

notation.P_k: physical source Sobolev norm of order k
notation.Q_k: same original Birkhoff image norm of order k
notation.M_k: weighted action l1 moment of order 2*k

existence.order: The original family is chosen once before all integer orders, real orders, weights and potentials.

remaining: Sequential integration of articles/dnls-estimates into main is a separate repository operation.
scope_note: Verified main statements of the pinned arXiv v2 source under the accepted Birkhoff-map reference; no journal-edition identity or audit of every intermediate statement is claimed.
